name: mercury-finance
description: Local ERP accounting tools for repository-scoped FlowAccount and PEAK work.

interface.shortDescription: Repository-local ERP tools for FlowAccount and PEAK workflows.
interface.longDescription: Mercury Finance runs one local stdio MCP for repository-scoped FlowAccount and PEAK setup, endpoint search, safe read actions, and approval-gated ERP writes. Credentials and execution audit data stay in the selected repository. Mercury Tools is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with Mercury Technologies, Inc.
defaultPrompt: Set up local FlowAccount access for this repository and verify it.
Search the local ERP action catalog and run a safe read action.
Preview an approval-gated PEAK write for this repository without executing it.
